verdict.rationale: telli's workflows can be triggered by call events (implied default) and now by a recurring schedule, and webhooks notify external systems on call events, showing some event-driven automation. However there's no documented rule-definition interface (conditions, event-type selection, if/then logic) for arbitrary events beyond calls/schedule. Missing for 10: explicit rule/condition builder, broader event-type coverage beyond calls, and evidence of user-defined trigger logic rather than fixed schedule/call triggers.
